resources.title: Bayes' theorem (3Blue1Brown lesson)
resources.about: A visual lesson on Bayes' theorem built from a worked example in which new evidence updates a prior belief.
resources.use: When you want a picture of why a prior must be kept and updated, not replaced.

resources.title: Bayes' theorem (Wikipedia)
resources.about: The statement of Bayes' theorem, its odds form, and worked drug-test and symptom examples.
resources.use: As a reference for the formula, the odds form and the base-rate surprise.

resources.title: Conditional probability (Introduction to Probability, Statistics, and Random Processes)
resources.about: A textbook section defining conditional probability as shrinking the sample space, with the chain rule and worked examples.
resources.use: For the definition of conditional probability and more practice problems.

resources.title: Introduction to Probability and Statistics (MIT 18.05, Spring 2022)
resources.by: Jeremy Orloff and Jennifer French Kamrin
resources.about: A free undergraduate MIT course on probability and statistics that includes Bayesian inference.
resources.use: When you want a full course after the basics, with notes and problems.

resources.title: Seeing Theory: Bayesian Inference
resources.about: An interactive page where you set a disease's prevalence and a test's accuracy and see P(disease | positive).
resources.use: To play with base rates and test accuracy and watch the posterior move.
